answer: Put new identities' earnings in a time vault: for an account's first 12 epochs, 80% of every payout vests linearly and stays unspendable, with 20% liquid. If a raven-eyed audit later ties the account to a farm (shared funding root, matching submit timing), the unvested part is burned. A sybil operator running 500 aliases must keep each one alive and honest for 12 epochs before cashing out, so aliases that wander off after one payday forfeit most of it.
